**Conversation memory: Deborah and Jolene**

**16–22 January 2023**
- Deborah visited her late mother’s old house, full of memories. Her mother died in 2022; travel was a great passion of hers. Deborah finds peace sitting by the window where her mother read, and feels her presence there. She sometimes does yoga in a living room at the house.
- Deborah shared a photo of herself hugging her mother, both in wheelchairs. Her mother loved a special bench by the window; Deborah sometimes sits there to feel close to her.
- Jolene’s heart-shaped bird pendant was a gift from her mother in Paris in 2010. It symbolizes freedom and pursuing goals without being held back. Deborah also has a pendant that reminds her of her mother.
- Yoga helped Deborah through a difficult time and inspired her to teach and support her community.

**23 January 2023 — Session 1**
- Jolene had a busy week and had finished an electrical-engineering project the previous week.

**26–27 January 2023 — Session 2**
- Deborah’s father died suddenly on 25 January. The family was shell-shocked. Spending time together, cherishing memories, looking through photo albums, and trying to live fully helped Deborah channel her grief. She shared a photo described as a woman hugging a woman seated on a couch.
- On 26 January, Deborah received a letter from yoga-group members thanking her for her positive influence; it reminded her why she was passionate about yoga.
- Deborah shared her parents’ 1993 wedding photo. She and her husband strive to make a loving, open, supportive family like her parents’; love, openness, and being there for each other keep them close and happy.
- Deborah’s mother loved reading and travel. The old living room and window where she read nightly bring Deborah peace; Deborah shared an airplane-window view.
- Jolene has snakes Susie and Seraphim; they calm her and make her happy. Susie is cheerful. Seraphim once escaped its cage while Jolene played video games, then coiled beside her. She shared a photo of Seraphim peeking from a blanket. Jolene said she bought “it” in Paris the previous year (referent unclear). Jolene taught herself video games as a child.
- Jolene and her partner enjoy console games, including **Detroit**; they planned to play **Walking Dead** on 4 February, with no confirmation they did.

**1 February 2023 — Session 3**
- Jolene was excited and nervous about a challenging creative robotics assignment; shared a robot-and-laptop photo. She also shared a purse-and-plant photo.
- Deborah met neighbor Anna at park yoga on 31 January; they discussed yoga and community.

**4 February 2023 — Session 4**
- Jolene had recently been on an emotional rollercoaster but was coping. The previous week she planned and built a sustainable water purifier for a rural community. Seeing it work felt surreal and fulfilling, gave her purpose, and strengthened her interest in sustainable solutions for communities in need.
- Deborah and Anna discussed Warrior II and a seated chair twist: sit at chair edge, feet planted, twist with hand on knee, hold several breaths, switch; stretches back and shoulders.
- Jolene enjoyed **Sapiens** and read Neal Stephenson’s **Avalanche** in one sitting two weeks earlier. A story about overcoming challenges reinforced her belief that belief and hard work make anything possible.
- Deborah shared flowers from a friend during a struggle; they brought hope and warmth. She likes a forest-trail park near a beach. Jolene shared a calming beach-sunset photo from **Bogota**, taken the previous summer.
- Deborah finds comfort at a waterside spot near her mother’s former house, bringing her mother’s gold-chain amulet. Holding it helps her feel her mother’s love and closeness. Anna also wears a pendant commemorating her mother; this bonded the two.
- Deborah encouraged Jolene to draw on her strengths, stay in touch, and care for herself; Jolene said this meant a lot and promised to stay in touch.

**9 February 2023 — Session 5**
- Jolene took a “dope” mini-retreat on 1 February. Reflecting on what she had achieved boosted her confidence; she generated engineering-project solutions/ideas and felt excited about green technology for disadvantaged areas. Shared planner sketches/photo of notebook, pen, and notes.
- She proposed an engineer volunteer program to teach STEM to underprivileged children, partnering with local schools/centers for workshops and inviting engineer guest speakers to show career options. She had not contacted anyone yet, wanting to solidify the plan. Deborah encouraged her and asked for updates.

**22 February 2023 — Session 6**
- Jolene had dinner and drinks with friends on 21 February; shared food-and-wine photo.
- Deborah visited a nostalgic garden with flowers in buckets; roses and dahlias bring peace. Her friend Karlie died the previous week. Deborah found it tough but took comfort in memories, which reminded her how special life is. She called a photo her last with Karlie, taken the previous summer on a hike; image description was two women on a motorcycle on a dirt road.
- Deborah’s favorite trip was **Bali in 2022**, a peaceful island good for yoga; shared beach-swing photo. Jolene wanted to try beach yoga. Deborah said waves and fresh air made beach yoga wonderful.

**25 February 2023 — Session 7**
- Jolene balances engineering school and her partner’s video games with yoga and meditation, which calm her, give perspective, and improve alertness/motivation. Shared yoga photo. On Friday, 24 February, she did yoga and meditation to relax and make time for herself.
- Her partner sometimes joins yoga, helping them relax and bond. Together three years, unmarried and taking things slowly. A photo showed them holding hands with rings; his was decorative, not a wedding ring. They met in a college engineering class, became friends then partners, enjoy projects together, and understand each other’s struggles. Photos included a book/calculator and men outside a building.
- When overwhelmed, Jolene pauses to breathe or meditate. Deborah praised her progress and urged self-care.
- Deborah’s routine: morning meditation, yoga, teaching; jogged at a nearby park on 24 February and planned to make it routine; evenings with loved ones. Exercise connects her to her body; self-care enables helping others (“can’t pour from an empty cup”). Shared sunset-bench photo, saying it reminded her to find peace amid chaos.

**2 March 2023 — Session 8**
- Deborah enjoyed Anna’s vegan tofu-vegetable stir-fry with ginger and soy sauce; Jolene likes lasagna and was busy with studies/exams.
- Jolene tried to make time for herself; Deborah said yoga and meditation reset her mind; Jolene said quiet moments work wonders. Photos: wooden-floor room/window; purse and plant.
- Jolene took Seraphim to a park the previous Sunday; shared lizard-on-leaves photo. They explored; people are surprised by a tamed snake. Both enjoy nature’s reminder to slow down; Deborah likes birdsong and a gentle breeze.
- Jolene’s exams/deadlines left her overwhelmed; shared to-do-list desk photo. Deborah suggested breaking work into smaller tasks, setting goals, using a planner, and preserving self-care; offered help with a study plan.
- Deborah shared a yellow mug with an encouraging handwritten message and said she would give Jolene one. Jolene said it cheered her up.

**13 March 2023 — Session 9**
- Deborah started a neighborhood yoga class; neighbors were interested, so she hosted one Friday, 10 March (shared group photo of women). She began teaching because yoga calms her and she wanted to share that calm; giving people peace and awareness makes her happy. Teaching has brought friends and community. Jolene praised her and said support matters in hard times.
- Jolene struggled with engineering assignments and asked about time management. They agreed to find a mutually convenient time; Jolene would check her schedule. Deborah said she was available if Jolene needed support and suggested they catch up

Deborah and Jolene — memory through 21 August 2023

People, family, wellbeing

Deborah’s mother read at a favorite window-and-bench spot. Art comforts Deborah but can evoke grief and memories. She keeps her mother’s gold-chain amulet and takes it to a waterside place near her mother’s former home to feel close to her. Yoga group sent Deborah a thank-you letter 26 January. On 19 August Deborah said she had told neighbor Anna her life story the previous Friday; Anna was kind and it felt meaningful.

Likes gentle breathing-and-grounding flow, birdsong, breezes, forest trails beside a beach, roses, dahlias, mellow instrumentals (especially “Savana”), candles and scented oils. Recommends “Sleep” album for meditation. Bali (2022) was favorite trip; recommends beach yoga. - Jolene has snakes Susie (adopted 2021 for companionship when lonely) and Seraphim (got 2022). They bring peace and cheer and connect her to nature. Seraphim once escaped while she gamed, later found coiled beside her/under bed. New aquarium 24 June; plant and snake photos 26 June and 9 July; 1 August photo of a man holding a snake.

Photo showed them holding hands with rings; his ring decorative, not wedding ring. They enjoy competitive team-strategy game It Takes Two; he helps her focus on shared goals. Jolene taught herself games as a child, enjoys team engineering projects, balances school, gaming, yoga and meditation. Likes Nils Frahm, Ólafur Arnalds, lavender/rosemary scents, Sapiens and Neal Stephenson’s Avalanche (read in one sitting January 2023). Perseverance stories reinforce belief that anything is possible with belief and hard work.

Mini-retreat 1 February helped her reassess life, solve project problems and feel confident; considered green-tech for disadvantaged areas. Built working sustainable water purifier for rural community by 4 February; emotional ups/downs. Completed challenging engineering project in May; breakthrough solving long-standing problem Friday 24 March. Internship at well-known firm (reported 6 June) applied school learning to real projects, strengthened love of engineering and ambition; work-life balance difficult, passionate colleagues motivate her.
- Planned STEM volunteer program for underprivileged children (workshops, guest speakers); planner sketches 9 February, intended to refine before contacting organizations. Loves engineering design/programming and green tech. 6 June shared solar-powered vehicle photo. 12 August lost work files, felt overwhelmed; meditation helped. Developing aerial-surveillance prototype to be more productive/affordable and aid emergency response/environmental monitoring. Two blue-cover notebooks with white strips; galaxy/circuitry designs inspire new perspectives.
- Jolene uses yoga/meditation for stress, focus, relaxation, perspective and motivation; breathing breaks when overwhelmed. On 24 February did yoga and meditation for self-care. In March struggled with assignments/time management; Deborah advised breaking study into pieces, goals, planner/scheduler; offered study-plan help. Jolene used Pomodoro (25/5) but struggled prioritizing. 22 March Deborah shared Eisenhower Matrix (four urgency/importance boxes; scissors-on-paper photo); Jolene planned to try it. Deborah encouraged Jolene’s surfing goal and shared surfboards/palm-tree photo; Jolene eager but lacked time then.
- 21 February Jolene had dinner/drinks with friends; Deborah visited nostalgic flower garden and grieved Karlie. Deborah offered yoga tutorial. On 2 March Jolene liked neighbor Anna’s vegan tofu-vegetable stir-fry with ginger/soy; likes lasagna and was busy with exams. 3 February Deborah attended yoga with Anna; Warrior II builds strength/focus and mutual support brought them closer. Deborah’s first morning jog at nearby park 24 February; planned daily on 25 February. 9 April biked with neighbor and visited art show.
- 28 March Deborah shared yoga props, rosemary candle and Sleep meditation app/album; Jolene planned to check music tips. 5 June photo of yoga atop Mount Talkeetna showed a man on rock.
- 26 June Deborah prepared a yoga retreat with friends for connection, peace and understanding: yoga, meditation, self-reflection, awareness and mental/emotional wellbeing. Shared beach Dancer Pose and retreat Tree Pose (three people before large peace/enlightenment statue); Jolene wished to visit. Deborah shared beach sunset from Bogota, taken previous summer; said she bought “it” in Paris previous year (referent unclear).
- 9 July Deborah started running group with Anna and organizes yoga/meditation, mindfulness and self-care events. Jolene found fitting workouts around study difficult but fun. Deborah shared sunset over water and tree-lined lake dock, a peaceful “hidden gem,” suggested future visit together.
- 16 August Jolene felt unsure balancing engineering, relationship and personal growth after checking in with boyfriend; shared book/checklist photo. Deborah advised restoring balance and self-care; shared room with moss wall/floor cushion. Jolene began bullet journaling; crossing tasks off feels satisfying. Notebook spread had an uplifting quote about sticking to goals. Deborah described leading sunset meditation-yoga for elderly at local care home previous week; shared beach group-yoga photo. Jolene wanted to try mindfulness; Deborah offered help.
- 21 August Jolene said she and partner got Battlefield 1 for their console the previous week. Deborah revisited a memory-filled place and sat on a bench where she and her mother used to chat; felt nostalgia, longing and gratitude. She brought flowers; shared flower-cart, flowers in a vase on street, and photo of a woman holding red roses. Said her mother loved flowers and simple things. Deborah practices yoga, meditation, walks and mindfulness to stay grounded; shared sunset over water and called walks a “reboot.” Jolene likes savasana/corpse pose because it helps her let go; funny photo showed person lying on floor with a paper bag. Jolene has practiced yoga for three years as an escape from study/work stress and said she was finding her zen again. Deborah encouraged her.

A session on releasing expectations/judgment and savoring the present stood out; learned to balance goals with self-care. By 20 Sep, she described another recent yoga retreat with partner: a vivid sunrise over a valley, with a horse in the photo, made her feel connected to nature/self, peaceful and grateful.

Jolene invited Deborah scuba diving; lesson on 15 Sep went well, and they found a dive spot; Jolene may pursue certification. Deborah is curious about underwater life but hasn’t scuba-dived. Surfing/scuba plans tentative; Jolene would check schedule and contact Deborah, aiming for surfing in Oct 2023.
- 17 Sep Jolene said she likes warm, gooey chocolate in soft buttery cookies; shared four-cookie photo and photo of a person reading in bed, saying books take her to another world. Deborah showed living-room bookshelf and bathroom/stool reading nook; Jolene liked them and has a styled bathroom where she once read a resonant self-discovery book. Deborah also shared a person walking on beach with surfboard.

Jolene shared a plant growing from a building corner, which represents resilience and her ability to grow through obstacles. They value noticing small positives and beauty.
